verdict.seen: First frame shows the lawn and a cut ground edge with no pit. The other two show a glass-walled pit with a tan sand floor and a dirt mound, but the water is clear and unmuddy.
verdict.problem: No muddy water fills the pit and no sand visibly sinks; show brown water pouring in and the sand settling to the floor.

verdict.seen: The pit holds sand. A sign shows 9, then 5, with a NO CURRENT caption. No meter reading is visible in the first frame, and the number never reaches zero.
verdict.problem: The reading only drops from 9 to 5 and never reaches 0; continue it down to 0.

verdict.seen: A dark navy layer sits at the top of the pit above the sand. It is the same height in all three frames. Dots appear only in the first frame.
verdict.problem: The dark dirt layer does not rise across the frames; animate it growing upward from the sand.

verdict.seen: A chain of brown balls arcs from the pit toward a grey furnace drum. The first frame shows white specks and no furnace. The balls start at the mound and do not clearly leave the pit.
verdict.problem: The sand stream does not visibly come from the pit and does not enter the furnace; make it rise out of the pit and pour into the furnace top.

verdict.seen: The furnace counter climbs from 20 to 2,000 and a flame with rising arrows glows on top. The sand stream is gone by the end.
A thin pipe appears from the furnace to a blue tank on the right edge. The tank is partly cut off by the frame edge. No gas is visibly flowing.
verdict.problem: The second tank is cropped at the frame edge and no gas flow is visible; reframe and show gas moving through the pipe.

verdict.seen: A puller machine appears at the right edge, cropped. No glowing melt and no crystal ingot are visible, and nothing turns.
verdict.problem: The puller is cut off and shows no glowing melt or crystal; reframe and show the ingot rising and turning.

verdict.seen: A yellow outline box surrounds the crystal puller, with the machine fully in view.
A flat dark slab sits at the right edge. In the last frame a small stack of discs appears there, tiny and half cut off.
verdict.problem: The wafers are tiny and cropped at the frame edge; show a clearly readable stack popping in.

verdict.seen: A printer machine with a wafer sits at the right edge, partly cropped. No light beam is visible.
verdict.problem: No light beam hits the wafer and the machine is cropped; add a visible beam and reframe.

verdict.seen: A counter at the right edge reads 0, then 0, then 15. It is partly cut off, and it does not reach 20 billion.
verdict.problem: The counter is cropped and stops at 15 rather than reaching 20 billion; reframe and finish the count.

verdict.seen: A DEAD CHIP caption appears. A few tiny dust specks sit near the printer at the frame edge, cropped. They are not clearly on the wafer.
verdict.problem: The dust is tiny, near the edge and not visibly landing on the wafer; show clear lumps falling and resting on it.

verdict.seen: Rain streaks and a few brown specks appear near the cropped printer on the right, with a BATCH RUINED caption.
verdict.problem: Mud is minimal and sits at the frame edge; show clearer mud blowing into the hall, centred in view.

verdict.seen: Rain is present in the first frame. A white roof on posts then covers the puller and printer, with white down arrows showing air flowing.
Small white stepping stones appear at the ground edge and a lamp shape hangs under the roof. The roof is cropped at the right edge. The lamp is dark and not clearly in place.
verdict.problem: The lamps and stepping stones are tiny and cropped; show them clearly and fully in view.

verdict.seen: The camera pulls back from the pit to the full build: pit, furnace, tank, puller and cleanroom with the printer, all on the lawn. The last frame shows everything in view.
